items.reasons: The light grey cap is a lit top plane above a short front face with a woofer cone and an amp-head slot. The dark outline and 3-step greys match the originals, the 1-tile footprint suits a floor speaker, and its base sits on the floor line.

A purikura booth is a walk-in booth that should tower over a person, but here it is about wardrobe size (roughly 1.5 tiles wide by 2 tall in the room), one size too small. The pink curtains and heart sign read fine, and the light top strip gives an acceptable top plane.

The cabinet is a flat front elevation: the red marquee and screen have no lit top plane, only about 1 row of red on top. The seat is a separate red blob on a dark block below the console, joined only by black, so it reads as detached rather than one footprint seen in 3/4.

The bags, belts and boxes are muddy brown and maroon blobs on a cream backing, so at 1x it reads as a generic cabinet, not an accessory display. The items have no clear outlines separating them, unlike the crisp bottles on the originals' cooler shelves.
